sourceTitle: NOAA Ocean Service — How many oceans are there?
exactSourceStatements: There is only one global ocean
Historically, there are four named oceans: the Atlantic, Pacific, Indian, and Arctic
most countries - including the United States - now recognize the Southern (Antarctic) as the fifth ocean
The boundaries of this ocean were proposed to the International Hydrographic Organization in 2000
not all countries agree on the proposed boundaries, so this has yet to be ratified by members of the IHO

authoringBlocker.whyNotSubstituted: `derya`/`behr` DENİZ demek; okyanus değil. Dört claim de okyanus ile deniz ayrımına dayandığı için ikame yapmak soruyu olgusal olarak bozardı — kaynağın söylemediğini söyletmek olurdu.
